concerns.text: FR-001 mandates Battery Archive ('No other dataset source may be substituted') but no verified programmatic download endpoint exists; the plan correctly blocks all result-producing tasks (SC-001, SC-002, SC-004–SC-007, SC-009, SC-010 unmeasurable). The spec itself is the root cause: it must either name a verified open mirror/endpoint for Battery Archive (or an equivalent multi-protocol battery cycling dataset) or relax FR-001 to permit a verified substitute. Until then FR-001, FR-011, FR-012 and eight SCs are unbacked in practice — route to clarified.
